newsitem.title: USA: Gap stock jumps on share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Gap stock jumps on share buyback.

text.p: The stock of Gap Inc. jumped Thursday after the retailer said its board had approved the repurchase of up to 30 million of its common shares.
Gap rose $1 to $28.50 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
It said the shares would be purchased in the open market over the next three years. The new programme follows the completion in October of an 18 million share buyback.
Gap, which has 280.8 million shares outstanding, said the new programme is intended, in part, to offset future dilution from stock-based incentive plans.
